hook: Which Ring doorbell should you buy?

picks.label: LOWEST PRICE
picks.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell (2K)
picks.line: Half price and wire-free, so it's the one for renters or anyone without doorbell wiring.

picks.label: BIG DROP
picks.name: Ring Battery Doorbell Plus + Chime
picks.line: Shows more of your doorstep, so you can see parcels. Close to half price as a bundle.

picks.label: BUDGET PICK
picks.name: Blink Outdoor 4 + free Blink Mini
picks.line: A wire-free outdoor camera plus an indoor one. Can save clips without a monthly plan.
